messages:
maria_support: FYI Finly is seeing continuous 429s on their dedicated pool after a plan migration ~09:12 PST. User impact: embeddings and chat generation requests returning quota_exceeded.
finly_csm: Customer says traffic pattern didn't change, just swapped to new reserved plan. They can repro from their side with a simple loop.
maria_support: Tenant ID: tenant_finly_42. Sample response body I got from their curl: `{"error":"quota_exceeded", "message":"per-tenant rate limit exceeded"}`. Response headers: `x-tenant-quota: 3600`, `x-tenant-quota-unit: minute`, `x-request-id: req-9a3f`.
rajan_eng: Can you paste the exact curl you used? also do we have any recent quota ingestion or deploys around 08:50-09:10?
maria_support: Reproducer curl: ```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"open-embed-1","input":"hello"}' -s
```
rajan_eng: Looking at the tenant_quotas table for tenant_finly_42: `quota_value=3600`, `quota_unit=minute`. Runtime meter expects units in `per_second` internally (we normalize to tokens/sec). If ingestion treated the unit as "minute" but runtime consumed it as seconds we could be 60x off. Can someone dump the raw ingestion event?
lena_infra: I pulled the ingestion events: quota_ingest svc version 3.7.2 got a config flip at 08:58 (commit 7d2b3f). The parser change added `unit` field but a fallback path sets `unit=second` when missing. In this case the UI stored `minute` but our normalize path didn't multiply by 60.
chris_oncall: Autoscaler behavior: pool stayed at 6 nodes, CPU ~20% but token-queue length spiked -> autoscaler didn't scale because policy looks at node-level CPU and cooldown 15m. So scaling doesn't help immediate throttle; it's a rate-window problem.
rajan_eng: Immediate mitigation: create temporary tenant override bump of 60x using admin API. Example: ```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/tenant_finly_42/overrides -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"rate_limit":216000, "unit":"second", "reason":"temp bump after misingest"}'
```
maria_support: Finly agreed to a temporary override while we patch. Please keep it scoped and expire after 24h.
lena_infra: For the permanent fix: run a DB migration to normalize units on existing quotas and add a validation check in quota_ingest. Draft SQL: ```sql
UPDATE tenant_quotas
SET normalized_quota = CASE
  WHEN quota_unit = 'minute' THEN quota_value * 60
  WHEN quota_unit = 'hour' THEN quota_value * 3600
  ELSE quota_value
END
WHERE normalized_quota IS NULL;
```
rajan_eng: I'll open a PR to add unit normalization + unit tests. Also add a watchdog that emits a metric when normalized_quota/quota_value ratio > 10 so we catch bad ingests.
chris_oncall: Deploybot shows a small config change to quota_ingest deployed at 08:58 (commit 7d2b3f) -> looks like the source. deploybot: `deploy success: quota-ingest svc prod @ 2026-03-17T08:58:21Z (commit 7d2b3f)`.
rajan_eng: Repro steps for infra to validate locally: run a spike script that sends 300 requests/sec for 2m using tenant_finly_42 creds; you'll see 429s if quota treated as per-second while UI set minute. Quick wrk example: ```bash
for i in {1..300}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $FINLY_KEY" -d '{"input":"x"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate & done; wait
```
maria_support: Done temporary override, customer confirmed success (429s dropped). Finly asked for timeline for permanent fix.
lena_infra: Timeline: PR today -> canary migration across 5% of tenants tomorrow 09:00 -> full migration next day pending metrics. I'll also add a retrospective note to include unit validation on UI side.
rajan_eng: Action items assigned: (1) me: PR + tests (2) lena: migration script + rollback plan (3) chris: adjust autoscaler metrics to include queue length as a scaling signal (4) maria: communicate ETA to Finly + keep override expiry.
maria_support: Created INC-8373 and linked customer case. Will postmortem after the migration completes. :white_check_mark:
